pool.text: Colonial authorities founded the city as a rail depot.
Nairobi replaced Mombasa as the capital of the region.
Authorities declared the area to be a municipality.
The stock exchange received official overseas recognition from London.
Nairobi became the capital of the Republic of Kenya.
A major conference centre opened to the public.
Terrorists bombed the United States Embassy located in downtown.
Several major global companies relocated their African headquarters here.
A notable local drama film came to the big screen.
A new railway connecting to the coast was inaugurated.
A new transport terminal began operations to improve public commuting.
A major expressway was completed to reduce traffic congestion.
A new sports stadium opened to host top flight tournaments.
The city reached the final for an international kindness competition.
